component: Native BF16 text embedding plus four-stream initialization, and final FP32 carried-pre head collapse

source.method: Unchanged original Embedding.forward,ExpandStreams.forward,HyperHead.forward and to2/to_device/hc_flush AST bodies executed in isolated bindings. Ordinary resident nn.Embedding; no indexed/draft overrides or pending HC apply. Source default embedding output F32, multiplier1,normalizeFalse.
source.original_reference: reference.json and hashes preserved; composed cases additionally captured through original HyperHead using frozen original embedding outputs, not candidate outputs.

implementation.embedding: BnGPUBF16EmbeddingHC4ResidentPlan / embedding_hc4_f32_resident, immutable model/backend-owned raw BF16[vocab,D] handle, request resident I32[R] IDs and F32[R,4,D] streams. One fused vector4 gather/bit expansion/broadcast kernel. Preserves subnormals, signed zeros and NaN payloads. No family scaling/normalization.
implementation.head: BnGPUHC4HeadResidentPlan / hc4_head_resident: cublasSgemmStridedBatched,Dx1x4 per row, FP32/default math with TF32 off. F32 streams[R,4,D],pre[R,4],out[R,D]. Uses vendor reduction rather than substituting HCmix FMA order.
implementation.workspace: Explicit setup-only hc4_head_workspace_size/reserve shares existing request FP32/EXL3 cuBLAS handle and16MiB workspace; no additional16MiB allocation if already reserved. Embedding shares existing embedding_bf16_reserve four-byte sticky error flag. Resident activations/IDs are caller budgeted; context/library/driver overhead separate.
implementation.geometry: HC4 R1..65535,D128..65536,D%4; actual qualified embedding R1/7/32/33/64/256/1024/4096,D5120 and synthetic D128/256/5120. Head actual R1/7/32/33/64/256,D5120 plus composed R1024/4096 and synthetic D128/5120.
implementation.validation: Owner/raw tag/type/shape/count/alignment, request generation and disjoint buffers checked before launch. Missing setup rejected. Bad device IDs never access outside table; next explicit fence fails and poisons only that request. Outputs valid only after successful fence. No allocation/copy/fence during either op.

reference.coverage: 18 embedding fixtures include all65536 BF16 bit patterns and boundary/permuted/repeated IDs, two request isolation, invalid-plan unchanged outputs, missing/idempotent reserve, four invalid ID classes and peer survival;12 head fixtures include subnormals/signed zeros/large values/four-term cancellation and shared workspace reuse. Inputs and guards unchanged. Actual model/shared embedding, all80 HC-site source carry/stream pairs, three repeats bitexact, plus fully queued fused embedding->head source composition.
reference.library_scope: Original Torch2.14.0+cu130 packaged cuBLAS versus installed system cuBLAS13.10: all tested head cases bitexact. No general cross-library GEMM equivalence claim.

profile.scope: Warmed raw BF16 embedding->F32 HC4 streams->FP32 vendor head collapse, actual shared model embedding and last-site carried pre,R256,D5120,64 fully queued pairs. Model preparation/request allocation/error flag/16MiB cuBLAS reserve outside capture.

limitations: The complete native transformer/generation graph is not wired yet. These qualified input/output operators now complement shared weights, RMSNorm and HC4 mix/apply; routing/FFNs, compressed/indexed attention/KV, Engram and graph/session admission remain.
Text raw BF16 embedding only; indexed/multimodal embeddings, TableEmbedding streaming/quantization and draft overrides need separate explicit implementation/admission.
Vendor FP32 head reductions depend on shape/library/hardware. At D128 source R1 differs from R>1; matched source R required. No arbitrary row-splitting numerical invariance claim.
Profile is a single warmed R256,D5120 composition. No model throughput, end-to-end generation, CPU/Metal execution or vLLM parity claim.
